newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on retail sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on retail sales.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on Friday after a month of steady gains following profit-taking by small investors, brokers said.
The all share index fell 3.9 points to close at 865.5. Blue chips Development Finance fell seven rupees to 318 and John Keells two to 385.
"The index was led down by John Keells and Development Finance, which are the two highest cap stocks trading in Colombo," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of brokerage John Keells.
"But the index showed early signs of weakening on retail profit-taking which was expected since it had risen sharply in July," he added.
